name: typo3-14-update-harness
description: Equality prover and security boundary for TYPO3 v14 update runs: guarded URL discovery, deterministic capture, three-stage comparison, backend sweep, and gated verdicts.

comment:removed-dependencies.axios: follows redirects internally, so the URL guard never sees the hops
comment:removed-dependencies.cheerio: replaced by a targeted <loc> extractor that refuses entity declarations
comment:removed-dependencies.dotenv: implicit .env loading from the skill directory leaked credentials across projects
comment:removed-dependencies.fs-extra: node:fs/promises covers mkdir recursive, rm and cp
comment:removed-dependencies.@playwright/test: the test runner was unused; node:test covers the tests
comment:removed-dependencies.linkedom: not needed: DOM normalisation and template signatures are dependency-free so the harness works before npm ci
